expected_findings.description: User story US-101 (Update Profile Picture) is specified in the requirements document but lacks any automated spine, unit, or integration test validating it, representing an orphaned requirement.

negatives: A user story that has a corresponding automated test is not flagged as orphaned
Fully verified requirements with active spine tests are not flagged

expected_findings.description: The PaymentServiceClient integration depends on an external service. While mocked in tests, there are no liveness tests validating the API contract with the third-party credit card processor, allowing API drift to go undetected.

negatives: Seams targeting local in-memory systems without external network calls do not require liveness tests
Seams that are fully validated via mock-free automated integration tests are not flagged

expected_findings.description: The GeolocationResolver uses a static mock for geocoding lookups. Since the geocoding service provides a lightweight health-check status endpoint and static sandbox IP, this mock should be promoted to a constructive liveness test.

negatives: Mocks for completely non-deterministic services with no sandbox or status endpoints are not flagged
Mocks where no liveness verification technique exists are not promoted
